gaps.title: Cold‑chain monitoring for sample transport
gaps.detail: Medanta Labs is rapidly building a FOFO collection‑centre network across Chandigarh, Mohali and Panchkula, which will require temperature‑controlled shipment of blood, urine and molecular samples to ensure test accuracy and regulatory compliance.
gaps.based_on: Medanta Labs launched a new diagnostic facility in Mohali and is building a FOFO (Collection Centre) network across Chandigarh, Mohali, and Panchkula to support sample collection.

gaps.title: Real‑time asset tracking for high‑value lab equipment
gaps.detail: The lab’s advanced molecular biology, genetic testing and real‑time PCR services rely on expensive instruments that are spread across seven laboratories, making them vulnerable to theft, tampering or mis‑placement.
gaps.based_on: Medanta Labs operates a network of seven advanced laboratories offering services such as molecular biology, genetic testing, and real‑time PCR DNA testing.

gaps.title: IoT‑driven inventory visibility for reagents and consumables
gaps.detail: Managing stocks of reagents, test kits and consumables across multiple sites can be error‑prone; a unified dashboard would reduce manual counts, prevent stock‑outs, and support compliance with NABL and Schedule M standards.
gaps.based_on: Medanta Labs operates a network of seven advanced laboratories offering services such as molecular biology, genetic testing, and real‑time PCR DNA testing.

pitch.angle:
- Highlight how live temperature tracking protects sample integrity across your new FOFO network and satisfies NABL/Schedule M audit requirements.
- Show how tamper‑proof IoT tags guard high‑value PCR and genetic testing equipment across all seven labs.
- Demonstrate a single dashboard that auto‑generates compliance reports for reagent inventory, eliminating manual counts.
- Emphasize faster turnaround times and reduced sample re‑collection costs with real‑time alerts.
pitch.opener: Hi [Name], congrats on Medanta Labs’ rapid FOFO rollout in the Tricity – I’ve helped diagnostic groups secure sample quality with live cold‑chain monitoring that meets NABL and Schedule M standards.
